start.title: Start a stock count
start.body: Everything, category, supplier, location or selected products
start.a1: Tap Start count and choose what you are counting: everything, one category, one supplier, one location or products you pick.
start.a2: The products in that scope are fixed when the count starts, so adding or editing products later does not change the count in progress.
start.a3: Choose scan mode or list mode, then count. Your progress is saved on this phone as you go.

scan.title: Scan products
scan.body: Repeated scans can add one each time
scan.a1: With Repeated scan +1 on, each scan adds one unit (or a whole pack or case for pack and case barcodes).
scan.a2: With it off, each scan opens the quantity so you type the number you counted.
scan.a3: Unknown barcodes can be added as new products without leaving the count.

caseLoose.title: Count cases + loose
caseLoose.body: Enter cases/packs and loose units together
caseLoose.a1: Turn on Case + loose, then enter full cases, packs and loose units. TillCount adds them up for you.
caseLoose.a2: A product needs its units per case (or a case barcode) for case counting.

reorder.title: Build a reorder list
reorder.body: Low stock and target quantity explained
reorder.a1: A product is low when its last counted quantity is at or below its reorder level, and out when it was counted as zero.
reorder.a2: Suggested order = target stock minus the last counted quantity, never below zero. TillCount does not forecast sales.
reorder.a3: Only completed counts are used. Products you skipped keep their previous quantity.

import.title: Import products
import.a1: Choose a CSV file, match its columns, then review every row before anything is imported.
import.a2: Rows that match an existing product by barcode or SKU are left unchanged unless you choose to update them.
import.a3: A Till-family transfer file from TillCalc moves product identity, barcodes and prices; no history is included.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.a1: Create an encrypted backup with a password you choose, then save the file somewhere you control.
backup.a2: Restoring checks the whole file first and replaces your data only after you confirm. If it is interrupted, your previous data comes back.
backup.a3: TillCount cannot recover a forgotten backup password.

support.title: Contact support
support.body: What to include and what never to send
support.a1: Email {{supportEmail}} with what you did, what you expected and what happened. The app version and phone model help.
support.a2: Never send backup passwords, backup files or your full product list unless we specifically ask and you are comfortable doing so.

internet.a: No. Counting and saved operational data work locally on the device.

live.q: Is the quantity always live stock?
live.a: No. It is the last counted quantity unless you complete another count.

skipped.a: Their previous quantity remains unchanged; they are never silently set to zero.

noBarcode.q: Can I count without a barcode?
noBarcode.a: Yes. Manual products can be counted by list or search.

caseLoose.q: Can I use cases and loose units?
caseLoose.a: Yes, when a product has pack/case quantity configured.

value.q: Is the stock value my accounting valuation?
value.a: No. It multiplies counted quantities by the cost prices you entered. It is not a formal accounting valuation.

reorder.q: How is the suggested order worked out?
reorder.a: Target stock minus the last counted quantity, never below zero. There is no forecasting.

backup.a: On this phone. Use encrypted backups to keep a copy somewhere you control.

transfer.q: Can I move products to TillCalc or TillLabel?
transfer.a: Yes. Create a Till-family transfer file and open it in the other app. Count history stays in TillCount.

privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: Products, barcodes, count sessions, reorder settings, suppliers, locations and preferences are stored for the app to work.
privacy.p2: Core operational data is designed to stay on your device unless you choose to export, share or restore a file. It is not sent to {{publisher}} servers.
privacy.p3: When you create a PDF, CSV or backup, you decide where that file is sent or saved.
privacy.p4: Do not send backup passwords or unnecessary private business data in support messages.
privacy.p5: The camera is used only while the barcode scanner is open, to read barcodes. No photos or video are stored or sent.
privacy.p6: TillCount contains no advertising, analytics or tracking SDKs and does not send usage data.
privacy.p7: If you buy TillCount Pro, the purchase is processed by Apple or Google and RevenueCat. They receive purchase details, never your products or counts.
privacy.p8: TillCount is a business tool and is not directed at children.
privacy.p9: If this policy changes, the new version will be shown in the app with a new date.
privacy.p10: Contact {{privacyEmail}} for privacy questions or requests.

terms.heading: Terms of use
terms.p1: TillCount is a stock-counting and reorder-list tool. You remain responsible for the quantities and information you enter.
terms.p2: Counts, targets, costs and reorder quantities depend on the data entered by you.
terms.p3: The app is provided as a practical business tool and does not replace professional accounting or inventory advice.
terms.p4: Use the backup tools and keep copies of important exports in storage you control.
terms.p6: TillCount Pro is a one-time purchase made through Apple or Google. Their terms and refund rules apply to the payment.
terms.p7: To the extent the law allows, {{publisher}} is not liable for business losses arising from decisions made using figures in the app.
terms.p8: Your data belongs to you. It is stored on your device and is not collected by {{publisher}}.
terms.h9: Changes to the app and these terms
terms.p9: We may update the app and these terms. The version in the app applies from its date.
terms.p10: These terms are governed by the laws of {{jurisdiction}}.

dataStorage.heading: Data storage notice
dataStorage.p1: Product records, counts, settings and history are stored locally for TillCount to operate.
dataStorage.p2: Encrypted backup files leave the app only when you choose where to save or share them.
dataStorage.p3: CSV, PDF and Till-family transfer files are created or read only when you start those actions.
dataStorage.p4: Local data may be lost if the app is removed without a backup.
dataStorage.p5: TillCount opts out of automatic cloud device backups, so your records are not copied to a cloud account without your choice.

disclaimer.heading: Disclaimer
disclaimer.p1: TillCount records what you count. It does not automatically track every sale, delivery, waste event or transfer.
disclaimer.p2: Suggested order quantity is based on your counted quantity and the target quantity you set.
disclaimer.p3: Any displayed stock-cost value is based on the cost prices you entered and is not formal accounting valuation.
disclaimer.p4: Check important quantities and reports before using them for purchasing or business decisions.
disclaimer.h5: Not an EPOS or accounting system
disclaimer.p5: TillCount does not connect to tills, suppliers or accounting software.
disclaimer.p6: If a translated text differs from the English version, the English version applies.
